summary: Examples of uri: checking for HTTP 200, failing if content lacks a word, creating a JIRA issue with JSON, logging in via form-urlencoded dict or tuples, and uploading files via multipart.
questions: How do I check a web page returns 200?
How do I fail if a page doesn't contain a word?
How do I POST JSON to create a JIRA issue?
How do I log in to a form and keep the cookie?
How do I upload a file with multipart/form-data?

answer_card.title: uri examples (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.uri: {url: http://www.example.com}
- ansible.builtin.uri: {url: http://www.example.com, return_content: true}
  register: this
  failed_when: "this is failed or 'AWESOME' not in this.content"
- ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: https://your.jira.example.com/rest/api/2/issue/
    user: your_username
    password: your_pass
    method: POST
    body: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.file','issue.json') }}"
    force_basic_auth: true
    status_code: 201
    body_format: json
- ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: https://your.form.based.auth.example.com/index.php
    method: POST
    body_format: form-urlencoded
    body: {name: your_username, password: your_password}
    status_code: 302
  register: login
```
